description: Na₆Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.74 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.00 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°.
